All nine final behavioral fixtures and both check modes passed. The refreshed audit has 1,017 inputs, 2,591 local links, zero focused/current reader-page candidates and 220 contextual candidates; inventory hashes match final inputs.

Fresh spawned author checks on affected 106/111/112/113 found no remaining findings; 109/110 received additional author inheritance checks. These are author self-checks only, never independent review or approval. Please perform the fresh 3096/3101/3102/3103 checks and base-only re-records under the round-2 ruling, then integrate bottom-up. The implementer will resume TASK-HOME-117 WIP and the ordered queue afterward.
